Fix the concurrency bug in counter/counter.go: Inc and Get are called from many goroutines and currently corrupt state (or crash with concurrent map writes). Make Counter safe for concurrent use while keeping its API unchanged.
Scope: counter/counter.go only
Acceptance criteria: 50 goroutines x 100 Inc yield exactly 5000 and no crash; go test ./... passes
Verify with: go test ./...
Stop when the tests pass.
